content.title: UConn's Azzi Fudd hints that she is 'Paige Bueckers' girlfriend' - Outsports
content.text: UConn's Azzi Fudd hints that she is 'Paige Bueckers' girlfriend' - Outsports Basketball fans buzzing as Azzi Fudd hints that she is ‘Paige Bueckers’ girlfriend’ The speculation around the former UConn teammates' relationship has its flames fanned once again, this time with a social media post. Connecticut guard Azzi Fudd (35) and guard Paige Bueckers (5) helped the Huskies win the NCAA title this spring. | Lucas Boland-Imagn Images Dallas Wings guard Paige Bueckers and guard Azzi Fudd played for the same Connecticut team when they brought the Huskies back to the top of women’s college basketball in their final game as college teammates in April, but the months of fan speculation around whether they “played for the same team” beyond the court appear to have reached a resolution. Fudd seemed to confirm that the two backcourt stars are indeed in a relationship via an Instagram story on Saturday. Fudd included a mirror selfie in the post that displays the phrase “Paige Bueckers’ Girlfriend” on her phone case, leading a wide swathe of the internet to view the post as a hard launch of their relationship. It’s no secret that the two women have been close friends since their high school days, and there have been discussions of the possibility of the two being together during their time together at UConn with many pointing to their frequent collaborations on sponsored NIL social media posts, along with the fact that neither has confirmed nor denied that they are together. Chatter around the relationship heated up following the WNBA Draft shortly after their NCAA championship run. Fudd was seated next to Bueckers at her draft table that night and was the first to embrace Bueckers when she was announced as the No. 1 overall pick. A YouTube video of Bueckers during draft night released by ESPN included a moment where she told Fudd and others she was “mic’d up,” which fed into the collective women’s basketball slice of social media’s speculation further. On May 23, the conversation around a possible Fudd and Bueckers relationship got another jolt when Fudd released a TikTok post of the two participating in the dinner bill meme with the caption “Princess treatment every time I’m with her #spoiled” complete with angel and heart emojis. As Charlotte Wilder and Madeline Hill of “The Sports Gossip” Podcast pointed out in the days following the post, “That’s not a trend you do with your best friend … especially the emoji use. Those emojis are not platonic.” Despite the internet’s universal ability to latch onto every little online detail surrounding something they collectively really want to be true, Fudd’s latest post is the closest confirmation that the two basketball stars are in a relationship. That being said, neither has 100% confirmed that they are dating beyond Fudd’s wonderful choice of phone decor. Hard launch, soft launch or simply a pump fake, Fudd and Bueckers clearly understand how to keep online audiences dialed in as they launch their bright futures in the WNBA. Who knows? When Fudd enters the league next year, fans might have another LGBTQ basketball power couple to warm their hearts.
